rows.title: ‘Crimson Peak’ Review & Round-up: Guillermo Del Toro Finds His Sweet Spot with Gothic Romantic Horror Hybrid
rows.comment: Del Toro has never made a more gorgeously wrought movie
rows.verdict_le10: Del Toro has never made a more gorgeously wrought movie
rows.dek_lead: Certainly, Del Toro has never made a more gorgeously wrought movie. The detail of the period sets–all character-driven–is Oscar-worthy, as are the directing, cinematography and costumes.
